title: Sunset food and craft beer walk in the old town
summary: An evening walk through the back alleys of the old town, pairing Greek craft beers with a full Cretan tasting menu. It ends at an outdoor spot overlooking the harbour lighthouse.
source_name: Tasty Beer Tours (ex Bonnie & Clyde Urban Tours)

title: Midday old town tasting walk with local beers
summary: A relaxed daytime walk through the quieter streets of the old town, with craft beer samples, a Greek food tasting menu and a session on local olive oil, honey and spirits.
source_name: Tasty Beer Tours (ex Bonnie & Clyde Urban Tours)

title: Old town food stories walking tour
summary: A walk through the municipal market, artisan workshops and the historic quarters, with about six tasting stops and a finish over mezedes and raki.

title: City food and market walk
summary: A walk between the market and long-standing specialty shops, tasting everyday local snacks and coffee along the way. Saturday departures add the farmers market.

title: Old town evening food walk
summary: Six tasting stops across the old town: a family tavern with raki, a bakery, a phyllo workshop in a Venetian building, wine pairings and a sweet finish.

title: Old town tasting walk with a local guide
summary: A guided walk starting from the main square and following the line of the old walls, with food stops led by someone who lives here.

title: Olive oil and honey countryside tasting with lunch
summary: A countryside trip to a family olive mill and a honey museum in the villages behind the coast, finishing with a shared lunch.

title: City centre food walking tour
summary: A walk through the city alleys with around fifteen tastings of traditional dishes, cheeses, honey, wine and raki, ending near the Venetian harbour.

title: Food stories neighbourhood walk
summary: Eight food stops including a bakery in operation for a century, market cheeses and olive oil, home-style dishes and Cretan wines.

title: Historic centre tasting and walking tour
summary: A compact walk through the historic centre combining Venetian-era sights with tastings of Greek coffee, small pies, olive oil, cheeses, dakos and wine.

title: Lakeside town walk with Cretan food tasting
summary: A coastal walk starting at the town lake, followed by a seated meal of traditional meze, a main dish and local wine. Vegetarian options are available.

title: Hands-on Cretan cooking class
summary: A small-group class with a chef covering classics such as tzatziki, Cretan salad and traditional pies, ending with a shared tasting of everything prepared.

title: Organic farm visit with a Cretan meal
summary: A visit to a family-run organic farm outside town, walking through herb fields and a small folklore collection, then sharing a traditional farm meal. By appointment.

title: Morning glass bottom boat cruise with swim stops
summary: A morning cruise from the old harbour on a glass bottom boat, passing a wild goat habitat and a submerged WWII aircraft, with swimming and snorkelling stops. Gear, fruit and soft drinks included.

title: Swimming trip to two nearby islands
summary: A trip from the old harbour out to two small islands, with time to swim near a nature reserve known for its wild goats. A drink is included.

title: One hour sunset cruise off the harbour
summary: A short evening cruise from the old harbour to watch the sunset from the water.

title: Full day catamaran cruise along the coast
summary: A day cruise from the Venetian harbour towards a bay further west, with two swim stops, brunch and a Cretan lunch on board. Small group, with paddleboards and snorkelling gear included.

title: Sunset catamaran cruise
summary: An evening catamaran outing from the harbour, a shorter format built around the sunset with drinks on board.

title: Day cruise to quiet beaches
summary: A boat day out of the harbour visiting several beaches that are hard to reach by land, with swimming breaks along the way.

title: Full day shared catamaran to the island opposite the city
summary: A shared catamaran day trip from the port to the uninhabited island facing the coast, with swim and snorkel stops in clear coves.

title: Half day sailing trip with swim stops
summary: A skippered sailing outing along the coast with swimming breaks, available as a shared or private trip.

title: Catamaran day cruise with meal and open bar
summary: A catamaran cruise to the island opposite the city with a meal cooked on board, drinks and snorkelling gear included.

title: Boat crossing to the island fortress
summary: Regular boat crossings to the historic fortress island in the gulf, with departures every half hour for most of the day from villages on the bay.

title: Afternoon bay cruise with island visit
summary: A four hour afternoon cruise around the bay including a stop at the historic island, with a snack and a drink on board.

title: Bay cruise with swim stops by a local boat cooperative
summary: A five hour cruise across the bay with swimming breaks, a sandwich and drinks included, run by a boat cooperative operating since 1970.

title: Private skippered cruise on the gulf
summary: A private cruise from the town port on a traditional boat or speedboat with a skipper, with snorkelling gear and insurance included. Priced per boat.

title: Day trip by boat to Chrissi island
summary: A fast boat crossing from the fishing harbour to the protected island south of town, with a full day to enjoy its cedar trees and shallow water. Return ticket and port charges included.

title: Semi-private cruise to Chrissi island
summary: A smaller-group version of the island day trip, with fewer passengers on board for a quieter crossing.

title: Comfort cruise to Chrissi with a meal on board
summary: A yacht trip to the island with a traditional Cretan meal served on board, plus drinks and snorkelling and fishing gear to use.

title: Samaria gorge day tour with hotel pickup
summary: A full day trip to the national park: bus to the plateau entrance, a 16 km self-paced descent through the gorge in 5 to 6 hours, then return by boat and coach. Entrance and ferry tickets are extra.

title: Guided Samaria gorge trip by coach
summary: A classic full day excursion with a mountain guide and pickup from many points around the city, walking the long gorge down to the south coast.

title: Samaria gorge hike with regional pickup
summary: A full day guided hike through the island's longest gorge, home to the native wild goat, with bus pickup from hotels across the region.

title: Samaria gorge day trip from Rethymno
summary: An early start by coach to the plateau, a self-paced 16 km descent through the gorge, free time in the seaside village at the exit, then boat and bus back. Entrance and boat tickets are extra.

title: Imbros gorge day trip with a swim after
summary: A day out to a shorter, family-friendly gorge with narrow rock passages, around two and a half hours of walking, plus time for a swim and lunch on the south coast.

title: River trekking in a gorge with waterfalls
summary: A guided river walk through a gorge south of the city, wading and swimming at waterfalls along the way.

title: Village to summit hike ending at Knossos
summary: A hike from a traditional village up an old path to a mountain summit south of the city, descending the far side and finishing with a visit to the Knossos archaeological site.

title: Forested gorge hike near a mountain village
summary: A gorge hike starting near a village in the southern foothills, climbing about 600 m through one of the island's few forested canyons.

title: Half day gorge hike from a nearby village
summary: A guided walk through a narrow gorge starting from a village close to town, with sections passing between high rock walls.

title: Gorge and forest walks in the hills above town
summary: Easy guided walks through a gorge and woodland near a well-known hill village a short drive from town.
